title: Electric Company is tempting but cash is needed for red rent
description: Electric Company is tempting but cash is needed for red rent. Auctioning the utility preserves cash because Beta's red houses make the next lap dangerous. A shallow policy would choose buy_property; the decisive detail is the current mix of liquidity, opponent cash, and set leverage.

final_action.public_message: I can't buy it, so let's start the auction.
final_action.private_thought: I have $145 cash, but the Electric Company costs $150. I cannot afford to purchase, so I must start an auction. Hopefully the other players will bid low, allowing me to acquire it later if needed.

breakdown.message: Chooses start_auction for this exact purchase/auction context.
